@copilot Please address the three unresolved cleanup comments on this PR.

1. In `CouchbaseSingletons.java` and `CouchbaseSpan.java`, replace `Boolean.TRUE.equals(config.getBoolean("emit_experimental_telemetry/development"))` with `config.getBoolean("emit_experimental_telemetry/development", false)`. Inline the private single-line helper in `CouchbaseSingletons` at its caller. In `CouchbaseSpan`, preserve any helper needed by existing tests.
2. In `CouchbaseClient30Test.java`, inline the short `assertGetSpan` assertion chains and use the conventional `experimental(value)` helper for attributes absent when experimental telemetry is disabled. Keep exact attribute assertions, the operation-ID prefix assertion when enabled, and its absence when disabled. Retain the outer enabled/disabled trace branches because enabling the flag changes the number of spans. Follow the nearby Couchbase 3.1/3.2 `experimental(value)` pattern rather than introducing another expected-value abstraction.

Keep the single primitive umbrella flag, its default of false, the removal of the old experimental-span-attributes setting and fallback, and the span-kind and instrumentation-scope corrections. Do not expand this into an unrelated cleanup of other tests. Validate the affected behavior in the existing default and experimental variants.

I am updating the PR description separately; leave that description intact.

replies.body: Addressed in commit `27d93f42`; the config getters now use explicit false defaults, and the Couchbase 3.0 assertions follow the existing experimental(value) pattern.

threads.body: [Testing] This user-visible scope rename for the legacy bridge is not covered by any Couchbase 3.1 assertion. `CouchbaseClient31Test` uses `waitAndAssertTracesWithoutScopeVersionVerification` and never inspects the scope name, so a regression back to `io.opentelemetry.javaagent.couchbase-3.1` would pass. Please assert `io.opentelemetry.couchbase-3.1` in an integration-test runtime that takes the `legacyBridge` branch, analogous to the new Couchbase 3.0 scope assertion.

threads.body:
```suggestion
- Removed `otel.instrumentation.couchbase.experimental-span-attributes`. Use `otel.instrumentation.couchbase.emit-experimental-telemetry=true` to enable experimental span attributes for Couchbase 2.x and 3.x. For Couchbase 3.x, this also enables the Couchbase Java SDK's internal `request_encoding` and `dispatch_to_server` spans.
- Couchbase 3.x operation spans now use the `CLIENT` span kind. Couchbase 3.0 and legacy-bridge 3.1 spans now use the `io.opentelemetry.couchbase-3.0` and `io.opentelemetry.couchbase-3.1` instrumentation scopes, respectively.
```

 ### ⚠️ Breaking changes
 
+- Couchbase experimental telemetry is now controlled by
+  `otel.instrumentation.couchbase.emit-experimental-telemetry=true`, which enables experimental span
+  attributes for Couchbase 2.x and 3.x and the SDK's known detail spans for Couchbase 3.x. Remove
+  `otel.instrumentation.couchbase.experimental-span-attributes` and its declarative equivalent
+  `java.couchbase.experimental_span_attributes/development`; use
+  `java.couchbase.emit_experimental_telemetry/development` or the flat property instead. Couchbase
+  3.x operation spans now have `CLIENT` kind, and Couchbase 3.0 and legacy-bridge 3.1 spans use the
+  `io.opentelemetry.couchbase-3.0` and `io.opentelemetry.couchbase-3.1` instrumentation scopes.
